title: A maximal bad quotient for Popescu approximation
statement: Let $R\to\Lambda$ be a regular ring map [def-weil-pbc-g-ring] of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] for which $\Lambda$ is not a filtered colimit of smooth $R$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-smooth-algebras]. There exist Noetherian rings $R\prime,\Lambda\prime$ and a regular map $R\prime\to\Lambda\prime$, with $R\prime\ne0$, such that $\Lambda\prime$ is not a filtered colimit of smooth $R\prime$-algebras, but for every nonzero ideal $J\subset R\prime$, $\Lambda\prime/J\Lambda\prime$ is a filtered colimit of smooth $R\prime/J$-algebras. The source ring remains in the universe of $R$, and the target remains in the universe of $\Lambda$.

proof.text: Quotients stay in the situation. Say that PT holds for a ring map $R\to\Lambda$ if $\Lambda$ is a filtered colimit of smooth $R$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-smooth-algebras]. Let $R\to\Lambda$ be a regular ring map [def-weil-pbc-g-ring] of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $I\subset R$ an ideal. Then $R/I$ and $\Lambda/I\Lambda$ are Noetherian (quotients of Noetherian rings: an ideal of the quotient is the image of an ideal, generated by the images of finitely many generators), $R\to R/I$ is of finite type (generated by no element), so by [lem-weil-pbc-regular-base-change] the base change $R/I\to\Lambda\otimes_RR/I$ is regular, and $\Lambda\otimes_RR/I\cong\Lambda/I\Lambda$ as $R/I$-algebras ($\lambda\otimes\bar r\mapsto\overline{r\lambda}$). So $R/I\to\Lambda/I\Lambda$ is again a regular ring map of Noetherian rings.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma Tag 07F5 (lemma-reduce-to-field, lines 2011-2064), first paragraph ('Note that R/I -> Lambda/I Lambda is another regular ring map of Noetherian rings, see More on Algebra, Lemma 07C1')

proof.text: Consider the set of ideals $I$ such that $R/I\to\Lambda/I\Lambda$ fails PT. The zero ideal is a member, by the canonical quotient-by-zero isomorphisms. Choose a maximal member by [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-ideal-set-maximal]. Put $R\prime=R/I$, $\Lambda\prime=\Lambda/I\Lambda$. They are Noetherian and the map is regular by the preceding step. Every nonzero ideal $J$ of $R\prime$ pulls back to an ideal strictly larger than $I$, where PT holds by maximality. The quotient-of-quotient isomorphisms transport this to PT for $R\prime/J\to\Lambda\prime/J\Lambda\prime$. The ring $R\prime$ is nonzero: a zero base forces a zero target, smooth over the base and hence its own constant filtered colimit, contradicting failure of PT. The two quotient carriers have the original universes.

theorem exists_popescu_maximal_bad_quotient
    (R : Type u) (Λ : Type (max u v)) [CommRing R] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra R Λ]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    (hreg : RingHom.IsRegular (algebraMap R Λ))
    (hbad : ¬ ObjectProperty.ind.{max u v}
      (fun B : CommAlgCat.{max u v} R ↦ Algebra.Smooth R B) (CommAlgCat.of R Λ)) :
    ∃ (R' : Type u) (Λ' : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing R') (_ : CommRing Λ')
      (_ : Algebra R' Λ') (_ : IsNoetherianRing R') (_ : IsNoetherianRing Λ')
      (_ : Nontrivial R'),
      RingHom.IsRegular (algebraMap R' Λ') ∧
      (¬ ObjectProperty.ind.{max u v}
        (fun B : CommAlgCat.{max u v} R' ↦ Algebra.Smooth R' B) (CommAlgCat.of R' Λ')) ∧
      ∀ (I : Ideal R'), I ≠ ⊥ →
        ObjectProperty.ind.{max u v}
          (fun B : CommAlgCat.{max u v} (R' ⧸ I) ↦ Algebra.Smooth (R' ⧸ I) B)
          (CommAlgCat.of (R' ⧸ I) (Λ' ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R' Λ')))
